pairs.subject: scheduling
pairs.evidence: app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:186 These routes book interview slots when a request arrives (confirm, reschedule, RSVP, invite minting, OAuth). No durable schedule, reconciliation loop, recurrence rule or event subscription is defined here: a case-insensitive grep of app/api/schedule and app/api/calendar for setInterval, cron, next_run, nextRun and cooldown found zero hits, so the subject's precondition (machinery that decides when deferred work fires) does not hold in this context.

techniques.evidence: app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:197 The only suppression here is a per-IP HTTP rate limit on a public door, which belongs to the rate-limiting subject. It does not suppress refires of a trigger reacting to a condition or event.
app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:227 Link expiry is checked lazily when a request arrives. No loop wakes after downtime to decide what missed due times are worth.
app/api/schedule/route.ts:210 Idempotency here is per request, against a booking row. There is no scheduled run that could come due while still executing.

pairs.registryProposal: The context map files interview self-scheduling (calendar booking) under the same word as the job-scheduling subject. A disambiguating use_when or not-applicable trigger such as "calendar or slot booking for humans, not deferred work" would stop this pair from being re-judged every sweep.
